---
name: Critique or risk
about: Challenge an assumption or identify a scientific, ethical, educational, or technical risk
title: "[Critique] "
labels: critique
assignees: ""
---

## Assumption or design choice being challenged

What part of the project concerns you?

## Concern

Describe the issue as specifically as possible.

## Why it matters

What harm, bias, error, or misunderstanding could result?

## Evidence or example

Include research, professional experience, counterexamples, or scenarios if available.

## Possible response

If you have one, suggest how the project might address the issue.

A proposed solution is not required.

Well-supported criticism is valuable on its own.
